home.lead: pacs.008 (FIToFICustomerCreditTransfer) is the message one bank sends to another to move a customer's money. It says who pays, who gets paid, how much, and which banks are involved.
home.lead2: This guide walks through one synthetic example, from plain-language explanation to the raw XML.
